title: Grok Build manifest traps
body: In .grok-plugin/plugin.json and .grok-plugin/marketplace.json, anchor every path with ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT} and never with ${VAR:-default} (Grok expands ${VAR} only), and name the marketplace plugin source by git URL, not "./" (its marketplace rejects it as "marketplace path is empty"). `grok plugin validate` passes on all of these, so check a change with `grok inspect` from an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE. Why: found on Grok 1.0.41 on 2026-09-23 with a manifest Grok accepted and partly ignored; the manifest registers hooks only, mirroring hooks/hooks.json. On 2026-10-21, installed from this checkout with `grok plugin install <path> --trust`, `grok inspect` listed its hooks and the skills /save, /recall and /deltadictum:review (Grok keeps /review); no live Grok session has been recorded, Grok not being signed in.
not_derivable: Grok accepts the broken manifests without an error; only a live grok inspect showed what it ignored.

evidence.summary: Grok Build install and status, moved from docs/integrations/grok-build.md on 2026-10-21.
2026-10-21: grok 1.0.41 installed the plugin from this checkout with --trust; grok inspect listed its hooks and the skills recall, save and review, review renamed /deltadictum:review.
